firstCause: The batch70 Small seat aimed the feet at the Horse's stirrups. Small legs reach about 0.35 of the 0.75 from saddle to stirrup, so the pelvis sat at height 1.63 against the accepted Medium 2.22, inside the Horse.
rigCompletion: Run h1: Character.EnsureBones stops mapping a part at the first bone the avatar lacks. The female doll lacks L_back_weapon_slot_10, so every later bone, including all R_ leg bones, stays rigid on the pelvis. A seated Small rider's view gets the missing bones with no geometry and rebuilds natively.
seatRule: A Small seat is a fixed offset from the mount's anchor bone, set from the mount's measured back. It does not depend on the animation pose at mounting. Feet are sized by each rig's own reach and straddle the back.
buildMeasurement: Fat and thin thigh and shin measured within 0.002 of the same race and sex in the default build, so each build declares its default rig's reach. Only hip width differs.

Horse.visualPass: Spread raised from 0.61 and drop eased from 0.67 after g2. That image was the native merge defect, not the skirt (see rigCompletion); g4 rendered these values clean on every male rig and far side, so they stay.

RidingDog.visualPass: Raised 0.03 and 0.02 and spread from 0.61 after r12 showed the near thigh lost in the fur mid-stride. A proposed 0.80 and 0.52 was never rendered and answered the native merge defect, so it was reverted before any launch used it.
